title: J.S.Bach "The Goldberg Variations" [ Glenn Gould ] (1955)
summary: Glenn Gould's 1955 recording of Bach's Goldberg Variations, uploaded as a continuous performance of about 39 minutes.
why: Recommended as the best-known and most famous recording of the Goldberg Variations.

quote.text: Glenn Gould's 1955 recording is perhaps the best known recording of this work
